styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Cabrito, carne asada and the city's famous breakfasts.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, Macroplaza and the old Barrio Antiguo streets.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Mountain views, canyon day trips and Fundidora's green paths.

stays.why: Walk to the Macroplaza, museums and the cathedral. Central for first-time visitors and close to Metrorrey.
Old-town streets with bars and restaurants on the doorstep. Livelier at night, quieter in the day.
Upscale area with malls, restaurants and mountain views. Good for business trips; you'll need taxis or a car.
Green park with museums and walking paths. Calm and family-friendly; a short ride from downtown.

food: Try cabrito (roast kid goat) and agujas de res (beef ribs). These are the local specialties.
Breakfast is big here: look for machacado con huevo (dried beef with eggs) and barbacoa on weekends.
Carne asada is a social event. Many restaurants grill at the table; book ahead on weekends.
Snack on a 'torta' or street tacos; prices are usually modest, but check the menu first.
For a splurge, San Pedro Garza García has many well-known restaurants. Reserve in advance.
more_time: Add a day trip to the mountains: check local operators for canyon and Parque Nacional Cumbres tours; prices vary, confirm on the day.
Museum fans can spend an extra half-day at the Museo de Historia Mexicana and MARCO near the Macroplaza.
With a car, drive to nearby towns like Santiago for a slower day; check road and opening times on the day.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Macroplaza museums, Barrio Antiguo and a proper cabrito dinner; add a night for a mountain day trip.

month_notes: January: cool mornings and evenings (9–19°C). Bring a jacket.
February: mild and dry, one of the most comfortable months.
March: warming up (14–26°C); a few more rainy days.
April: hot afternoons (up to 29°C); plan outdoor time in the morning.
May: hot and rainier (11 rain days). Carry a light rain layer.
June: hot (33°C highs) and humid; stay hydrated.
July: the hottest month (34°C). Do outdoor sights early or late.
August: hot and humid, similar to July. Indoor museums are a good bet.
September: still hot with the most rain days (11). Watch afternoon storms.
October: cooling down (18–27°C); pleasant for walking.
November: mild and drier; good for parks and day trips.
December: cool (11–21°C) with a few rainy days. Pack a warm layer.

climate_guide.summary: Semi-arid climate with hot summers and mild winters. Rain is modest but peaks in May and September.

items.title: Best time: November to March
items.text: Mild days around 19–26°C and cool evenings. Good for walking the Macroplaza and parks.

items.title: Summer is hot (June to August)
items.text: Highs around 33–34°C. Do outdoor sights early morning; use air-conditioned museums midday.

items.title: Rain peaks in May and September
items.text: About 11 rain days in each. Showers are often short; carry a light rain jacket.

items.title: Big day–night swing in winter
items.text: January lows near 9°C and highs near 19°C. Layer up.

items.title: Humidity in summer
items.text: June to September feel muggy. Drink water and take breaks.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light clothes for summer, a warm layer for winter nights, sunscreen, and a light rain layer for May and September.

transit.best: Metrorrey for downtown hops; Uber or DiDi for everything else.

modes.text: Metrorrey is clean and cheap: about M$8.70 per ride. A rechargeable card costs about M$20.
City buses cost about M$15. Pay with a 'Me Muevo' card or the Urbani app; cash is being phased out. Ecovia BRT runs fast buses on Av. Ruiz Cortines, with free transfers to Metrorrey.
Uber and DiDi both work well. Taxis are green-and-white or yellow-and-white; insist the driver uses the meter.
Driving is possible but traffic and parking are tricky. Downtown hotels often offer free parking.
Good around the Macroplaza and Barrio Antiguo. Use rides for longer hops, especially in summer heat.
